subject_line: Application for Full Stack Intern — Ayushkumar Burde
body:
I am a Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in React JS and Node.js. I am applying for this role because the requirement to build scalable application components using modern technologies aligns with my freelance work.

I built a client inventory management system using React JS and Node.js that handles authentication and REST APIs. I also optimized SQL Server queries for CrystalTech Services, reducing response time by 60% to meet performance requirements.

I bring practical experience with Docker containerization and AWS deployment to your team. Let’s discuss how I can contribute to your projects.
